title: claude-real-video lets Claude actually watch a video instead of just reading its transcript
description:
claude-real-video lets Claude actually watch a video instead of just reading its transcript. Paste a YouTube link into most tools and the model never sees a single frame; Gemini samples at a fixed one-per-second and misses fast cuts entirely. This detects real scene changes, so a ten-minute static slide collapses to one frame while a rapid-cut reel keeps every beat. It dedupes repeated shots, transcribes the audio, and hands you a folder any model can read. #github #opensource 

https://github.com/HUANGCHIHHUNGLeo/claude-real-video
